adoption_scope_en: Component-level adoption: adopts only the SEB node_schema component (five required fields and their machine rules) for the six station-hall service nodes; claims no SEB open level (L0-L4) and adopts neither the scoring calibres nor the adjudication rules.

validity_note_zh: 全部节点为概念设计（G0、未运行）；节点数据为设计目标值，不产生任何绩效指标。ai_off_path 均为不依赖同一系统的实体路径（人工问询/纸质导览/实体导视），符合 forbidden_dependency 判据；human_handoff 为可问责具名角色（值班服务岗），非机构名。
validity_note_en: All nodes are concept designs (G0, not operating); node data are design targets producing no performance metrics. Every ai_off_path is a physical route independent of the same system (staffed desk / printed guide / physical signage), satisfying the forbidden_dependency rule; human_handoff values are accountable named roles, not institution names.
boundary_zh: 本采纳为参与者自设通道的开放共创行为，不代表任何机构采用该基准；字段齐备不证明任何服务已运行、已获批准或存在政府承诺。
boundary_en: This adoption is an open co-creation act on a participant-run channel; it represents adoption by no institution. Complete fields prove no service is running, approved, or government-committed.
